_comment: Schema: { file, purpose, readWhen }. The component catalog tracks every shared component in components/. Agents MUST check here before building a new component — if a variant already exists, extend it rather than creating a parallel implementation. When a new shared component is added, add an entry here and create the spec file at Docs/components/<slug>.md. Built: button, race-badge, placement-badge, data-table, site-header. Planned (ROADMAP: Component library baseline): price-chip, input, modal, toast.
purpose: Primary interaction trigger. Variants: primary, secondary, destructive, ghost. Sizes: sm, md, lg. States: default, hover, focus, disabled, loading (spinner + aria-busy). All variants are keyboard-accessible and meet WCAG AA contrast.
readWhen: Rendering any clickable action trigger, or before building a new button-like element — check if an existing variant covers the need before creating a new component.

purpose: Shows a race as a letter chip (T/Z/P) or full name, using the race color tokens: pale background for data cells, dark only in headers. Always includes text, never color alone.
readWhen: Displaying a player's race anywhere, or coloring a row or cell by race.

purpose: Renders an exported PlacementValue (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, ranges like 9th–12th, In progress) with tiered emphasis for champion, finalist, and playoff placements.
readWhen: Showing a season placement or best finish in tables, timelines, or player headers.

purpose: Sortable, sticky-header table for stats pages. Columns declared with accessor, header, align, and optional sort comparator. Renders on the server; sort is the only client island.
readWhen: Rendering any stats table (placements, ELO, race stats) or a leaderboard.

purpose: Displays an outcome price as a percentage with an optional up/down delta since a reference time. Text carries the direction (▲/▼ plus number), not just color.
readWhen: Showing a market or outcome price, or a price change, anywhere in the UI.

purpose: Site name and main navigation (Seasons, Players, ELO, Head-to-head, Races). Rendered once by the root layout.
readWhen: Adding a top-level section to the site, or changing the main navigation.
